summary: Contestants create a digital portfolio, resume, and cover letter tailored to a job at Digital Solutions, then participate in a virtual interview. All materials are submitted online and judged virtually, with finalists presenting live via videoconference. The event tests job search, portfolio, and interview skills in a professional virtual setting.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than ten (10) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
submission_requirements: Submit all required items in one combined PDF to https://upload.bpa.org
Contestant ID is required for all submissions
Materials from non-registered members and/or those missing Contestant ID cannot be accepted
deadlines: Event registration deadline: no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time, on December 1, 2026
Submission deadline: January 15, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
Online digital portfolios must be live and working between January 15 – March 1 for judging purposes
competencies: Apply technical writing skills to produce a professional cover letter, resume, and digital portfolio tailored to a targeted job opportunity
Conduct job market research to identify position qualifications, required skills, and industry expectations, and align application materials accordingly
Demonstrate knowledge of employability skills and job advancement strategies, including the professional behaviors and competencies required to obtain, retain, and grow within a career
Project a professional image through appearance, demeanor, and conduct that reflects workplace standards and expectations in a virtual environment
Demonstrate effective communication and interpersonal skills, and apply knowledge of workplace ethics and professional environment expectations to interact appropriately in a business setting

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy.

The following items have been submitted in one combined (1) PDF.
1. Digital Portfolio
2. Cover Letter
3. Resume
4. Works Cited
5. BPA Release Form(s)
6. AI Usage and Documentation Form

rubric.description: Introduction is engaging and tailored to the position and audience.
Skills are well -articulated and strongly aligned with the role.
Closing is confident, polished, and leaves a strong impression.
Writing is polished, precise, and enhances clarity and professionalism.
Position is clearly stated and strategically aligned with resume content.
Layout is professional, visually appealing, and enhances readability.
Work history is thorough, well-organized, and highlights relevant experience and is in reverse chronological.
Writing is polished, precise, and enhances clarity and professionalism.
Work samples are diverse, high-quality, and strongly showcase relevant skills.
Credentials are well -selected, clearly presented, and enhance qualifications.
Portfolio is professionally designed, visually engaging, and easy to navigate.
Statement is compelling, well-written, and clearly tailored to the position.

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Introduction is confident, polished, and immediately engaging.
Appearance is highly professional and enhances overall presentation.
Displays strong presence, sincerity, and poise throughout.
Communicates with clarity, warmth, and excellent verbal skills.
Responses are thoughtful, informed, and demonstrate enthusiasm and initiative.
Clearly showcases strong skills, problem-solving abilities, and professionalism.
Concludes with confidence, professionalism, and a lasting positive impression.

judging_notes: Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level.
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC.
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring.
eligibility_notes: Any middle level, secondary, or postsecondary contestant may enter this event.
There are no restrictions on the number of entries per chapter or per state.

Contestants who do not submit an entry following the topic listed below or do not follow the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy will be disqualified.
